name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot CRM integration for managing contacts, companies, deals, and support tickets with advanced pipeline analytics and UTC date handling

get_contact.description: Retrieve a HubSpot contact by ID or email address. Supports custom properties. Use the ID for contacts linked to tasks, deals or companies

contact_id.description: HubSpot contact ID. Takes precedence over email

email.description: Email address of the contact to retrieve, when contact_id isn't known

properties.description: Optional list of specific properties to retrieve (including custom properties). If not provided, returns standard properties (email, firstname, lastname, phone, company, jobtitle).

contact.description: HubSpot contact record from CRM v3 API

properties.description: Contact properties

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when contact was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when contact was last updated

error.description: Error message if contact not found

after.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

contact_id.description: The contact ID to associate the note with (optional)

company_id.description: The company ID to associate the note with (optional)

deal_id.description: The deal ID to associate the note with (optional)

associations.description: HubSpot associations array (native format) for linking the note to more records. Each entry must include 'to' (with record id) and 'types' (with associationCategory and associationTypeId, e.g. HUBSPOT_DEFINED 202 for a contact, 190 company, 214 deal, 228 ticket)

id.description: The unique ID of the record to associate

associationTypeId.description: HubSpot association type ID for the relationship

timestamp.description: Custom timestamp in milliseconds (optional, defaults to current time)

log_linkedin_messages.description: Log a LinkedIn message on up to 100 existing HubSpot contacts in one call, for example people who accepted a LinkedIn connection request. Each row is matched to exactly one contact by contact ID, email, or first and last name; rows that match no contact or several contacts are reported and not logged. To add people who are not in HubSpot yet, run upsert_contacts first and pass each returned contact_id in the message row.

messages.description: One row per person. Identify each person by contact_id, email, or first_name and last_name (checked in that order).

first_name.description: Contact first name, used with last_name when there is no contact_id or email (optional)

last_name.description: Contact last name, used with first_name when there is no contact_id or email (optional)

message_body.description: Message text for this row (optional, defaults to default_message_body)

timestamp.description: When the message was sent: Unix timestamp in milliseconds or an ISO 8601 date such as 2026-10-21T09:30:00Z, read as UTC when it has no time zone (optional, defaults to now)

company_id.description: Company ID to also associate the message with (optional)

deal_id.description: Deal ID to also associate the message with (optional)

default_message_body.description: Message text used for rows without their own message_body, e.g. 'Accepted LinkedIn connection request'

hubspot_owner_id.description: Owner ID shown as the author of every logged message (optional)

results.description: One result per input row, in input order

row_index.description: Position of the row in the messages input

identifier.description: How the row identified the contact, e.g. 'email:jo@example.com'

communication_id.description: ID of the logged LinkedIn message

candidates.description: Matching contact IDs when the row was ambiguous

error.description: Why the row was not logged

ambiguous.description: Rows matching more than one contact

invalid.description: Rows missing an identifier or message body, with an unreadable timestamp, or linking a company or deal that does not exist

failed.description: Rows whose contact, company or deal lookup or message create failed; see each row's error

unmatched_communication_ids.description: IDs of messages HubSpot created without saying which row each belongs to. Those rows have communication_id null; use these IDs to read, update or delete the messages

success.description: True when every row was logged

delete_linkedin_message.description: Delete a logged LinkedIn message. HubSpot moves it to the recycling bin, where it can be restored for 90 days.

list_tasks.description: Retrieve HubSpot tasks. With no filters, lists every task in ID order. Add filters (owner, status, priority, type, due date range, linked contact/company/deal, or text) to search instead; filtered results are sorted by due date.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to retrieve (default: 100, max: 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor from paging.next.after of the previous call, made with the same filters (optional)

hs_task_properties.description: Optional list of HubSpot task CRM property internal names to retrieve (e.g. hs_task_body, hs_task_subject, hs_task_status, hs_task_priority, hs_task_type, hubspot_owner_id, hs_task_reminders, hs_timestamp, hs_createdate, hs_lastmodifieddate). When omitted, a default set aligned with create_task/update_task is used.

owner_id.description: Only tasks assigned to this HubSpot owner ID (hubspot_owner_id)

owner_email.description: Only tasks assigned to the HubSpot user with this email. Ignored when owner_id is given

status.description: Only tasks with one of these statuses (hs_task_status)

exclude_completed.description: Leave out completed tasks (hs_task_status is not COMPLETED)

priority.description: Only tasks with one of these priorities (hs_task_priority)

task_type.description: Only tasks of one of these types (hs_task_type), e.g. CALL, EMAIL, TODO

due_after.description: Only tasks due at or after this time (hs_timestamp). Unix milliseconds or ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-27T00:00:00+13:00 for local midnight; a date without a time zone is read as UTC

due_before.description: Only tasks due before this time (hs_timestamp), exclusive. Unix milliseconds or ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-28T00:00:00+13:00 for everything overdue or due today in New Zealand; a date without a time zone is read as UTC

label.description: Label shown in HubSpot; null for the default unlabelled type

create_association.description: Link two HubSpot records, such as a contact to a company or a contact to a deal. Uses HubSpot's default association type unless a label (e.g. 'Architect') or association type ID is given

to_object_type.description: Type of the record to link to

to_object_id.description: ID of the record to link to

label.description: Association label to apply, matched case-insensitively. Get Association Labels lists the labels for the two record types

association_type_id.description: Association type ID to apply, from Get Association Labels. Takes precedence over label

get_owner.description: Retrieve a HubSpot owner by their ID. Returns owner details including name, email, and team information.

owner_id.description: The ID of the owner to retrieve

primary.description: Whether this is the primary team

error.description: Error message if owner retrieval failed

search_owners.description: Find HubSpot owners (the users who can own records) by email or name, or list them all. Use the owner ID to filter records by hubspot_owner_id

name.description: Text the owner's full name contains (case-insensitive), e.g. a first name

id.description: Owner ID, the value of hubspot_owner_id

complete.description: False when the portal has more than 2,000 owners and only the first 2,000 were searched

search_crm_objects.description: Search any HubSpot object type (contacts, companies, deals, tickets, tasks, notes, calls, emails, meetings, etc.) with HubSpot's filters, text query, sort and paging. Use for questions the other actions' fixed filters can't answer, e.g. deals in a stage closing this month, or emails on a deal since a date

object_type.description: Object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, tasks, notes, calls, emails, meetings, line_items, products or quotes

propertyName.description: Internal property name, e.g. dealstage or hs_timestamp. Get Object Properties lists them

value.description: Value to compare with. Dates are Unix milliseconds. CONTAINS_TOKEN accepts * wildcards, e.g. *@example.com

values.description: Values for IN and NOT_IN. Enumeration values are case-sensitive internal values

highValue.description: Upper bound for BETWEEN, with value as the lower bound

filters.description: Filters a record must all match (AND). Use filter_groups instead for OR

filter_groups.description: Groups of filters: a record matches when it matches every filter in any one group (OR across groups). Up to 5 groups, 6 filters per group and 18 filters in total

propertyName.description: Internal property name, e.g. dealstage or hs_timestamp. Get Object Properties lists them

value.description: Value to compare with. Dates are Unix milliseconds. CONTAINS_TOKEN accepts * wildcards, e.g. *@example.com

values.description: Values for IN and NOT_IN. Enumeration values are case-sensitive internal values

highValue.description: Upper bound for BETWEEN, with value as the lower bound

associated_with.description: Only return records linked to this record, e.g. notes on a deal

query.description: Text to search for across the object type's default text properties

properties.description: Properties to return. Defaults to HubSpot's standard set for the object type

sort_property.description: Property to sort by, e.g. createdate or hs_timestamp

sort_direction.description: Sort direction when sort_property is given

limit.description: Records per page (default 100, max 200)

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's after output, to get the next page. HubSpot stops at 10,000 results

include_urls.description: Add each record's HubSpot page link as url (contacts, companies, deals and tickets). Costs one extra request

properties.description: Requested property values; unset properties are null

url.description: Record's page in HubSpot, when include_urls is true

after.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

get_crm_objects.description: Read up to 100 records of any HubSpot object type by ID, or by a unique property such as email, with the properties and linked records you ask for

object_type.description: Object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, tasks, notes, calls, emails, meetings, line_items, products or quotes

ids.description: Record IDs, or values of id_property

id_property.description: Unique property the ids are values of, e.g. email for contacts. Defaults to the record ID

properties.description: Properties to return. Defaults to HubSpot's standard set for the object type

associations.description: Linked record types to include for each record, e.g. ["contacts", "companies"]. Up to 100 per type per record

include_urls.description: Add each record's HubSpot page link as url (contacts, companies, deals and tickets). Costs one extra request

properties.description: Requested property values; unset properties are null

url.description: Record's page in HubSpot, when include_urls is true

associations.description: Per requested type, linked records as {toObjectId, associationTypes: [{category, typeId, label}]}

associations_with_more.description: Types with more than 100 linked records, of which only 100 are listed

not_found.description: Requested IDs that matched no record

errors.description: Other errors HubSpot reported for some IDs

get_object_properties.description: List the properties of any HubSpot object type, including custom properties, to find the internal names and dropdown values to filter, sort or update by

object_type.description: Object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, tasks, notes, calls, emails, meetings, line_items, products or quotes

query.description: Only return properties whose internal name or label contains this text (case-insensitive)

include_details.description: Include field type, group, description and dropdown options

properties.description: Properties of the object type

name.description: Internal name used in filters and updates

type.description: Data type, e.g. string, number, date, enumeration

options.description: Dropdown options; filter and update with value

get_account_details.description: Get the connected HubSpot account's ID, time zone, currency and app domain, e.g. to work out today's date in the account's time zone

get_marketing_emails.description: List marketing emails from HubSpot, optionally filtered by archived or published status.

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return (default: 50, max: 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor for fetching next page of results

archived.description: Return archived emails instead of active ones (default: false)

is_published.description: true for only published emails, false for only unpublished (draft) emails; omit for both

state.description: Email state (e.g. DRAFT, PUBLISHED, SCHEDULED, AUTOMATED)

after.description: Cursor for next page

get_campaigns.description: List marketing campaigns from HubSpot. Returns campaign details including name, status, dates, and notes.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (default: 50, max: 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor for fetching next page of results

name.description: Filter campaigns by name (partial match on hs_name property)

sort.description: Sort order for results. Prefix with - for descending order.

after.description: Cursor for next page

get_campaign.description: Retrieve a single campaign by ID with optional metrics for a date range.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to retrieve

start_date.description: Start date for metrics (YYYY-MM-DD format). If provided with end_date, returns campaign metrics.

end_date.description: End date for metrics (YYYY-MM-DD format). Required if start_date is provided.

metrics.description: Campaign metrics for the specified date range (only if dates provided)

error.description: Error message if campaign retrieval failed

get_campaign_assets.description: Retrieve assets (landing pages, emails, forms, blog posts) associated with a campaign, including performance metrics.

start_date.description: Start of the metrics period (YYYY-MM-DD). HubSpot only returns asset metrics when start_date and end_date are given

end_date.description: End of the metrics period (YYYY-MM-DD). HubSpot only returns asset metrics when start_date and end_date are given

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return (default: 50, max: 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor for next page

get_campaign_performance.description: Get comprehensive performance report for a campaign including all asset types, aggregated metrics, website traffic, and contact lifecycle data.

start_date.description: Start of the metrics period (YYYY-MM-DD). HubSpot only returns asset metrics when start_date and end_date are given

end_date.description: End of the metrics period (YYYY-MM-DD). HubSpot only returns asset metrics when start_date and end_date are given

date_range.description: The metrics period that was requested

total_assets.description: Total number of assets across all types

landing_page_metrics.description: Aggregated landing page metrics (views, submissions, contacts)

email_metrics.description: Aggregated email metrics (sent, opens, clicks, etc.)

error.description: Error message if performance retrieval failed

get_contact_calls_and_meetings.description: Retrieve calls and meetings (with transcripts) associated with a HubSpot contact

contact_id.description: The internal object ID of the contact

limit.description: Max calls/meetings to retrieve each (default: 50, max: 100)

calls.description: Calls with transcript utterances (Google Meet transcripts are stored on call records)

hs_call_transcription_id.description: Transcript ID (may be null due to known HubSpot bug even when transcript exists)

transcript.description: Transcript utterances from the HubSpot Calling Transcripts API. Each item contains speakerId, text, and timestamp.

transcript_error.description: Why the call's transcript couldn't be read, when HubSpot has one that failed to load

meetings.description: Meetings with metadata (title, time, location). Transcript content is on call records, not meetings.

get_deal_calls_and_meetings.description: Retrieve calls and meetings (with transcripts) associated with a HubSpot deal

deal_id.description: The internal object ID of the deal

limit.description: Max calls/meetings to retrieve each (default: 50, max: 100)

calls.description: Calls with transcript utterances (Google Meet transcripts are stored on call records)

hs_call_transcription_id.description: Transcript ID (may be null due to known HubSpot bug even when transcript exists)

transcript.description: Transcript utterances from the HubSpot Calling Transcripts API. Each item contains speakerId, text, and timestamp.

transcript_error.description: Why the call's transcript couldn't be read, when HubSpot has one that failed to load

meetings.description: Meetings with metadata (title, time, location). Transcript content is on call records, not meetings.

get_call_transcript.description: Retrieve structured transcript utterances (with speaker IDs and timestamps) for a HubSpot call. Use this to get the full speaker breakdown of a call transcript. The transcript_id can be found in hs_call_transcription_id on the call record, or use the call record ID directly if hs_call_has_transcript is true.

transcript_id.description: The transcript ID (hs_call_transcription_id from the call record, or the call record ID as a fallback)

utterances.description: Structured transcript utterances with speaker info and timestamps

startTimeMillis.description: Start time in milliseconds from start of call

endTimeMillis.description: End time in milliseconds from start of call

total_utterances.description: Number of utterances in the transcript
